overview_description.description: QueryPie AI is an enterprise AI platform designed to securely operate AI agents in enterprise environments. Built on an MCP-based architecture, it connects internal data and diverse business systems while enforcing access control and centralized management. This enables organizations to execute AI Transformation (AX) with security as a foundation and extend AI adoption into practical automation and tangible business outcomes.

product.name: QueryPie Secure Enterprise AI Hub
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes and secures data access control across multiple environments including AI, cloud, SaaS, and on-premises.

product.name: QueryPie AI Agents
product.description: Customizable AI agents that automate workflows and interact with tools and data through natural language commands.

product.name: Access Control and Policy Management
product.description: A system for managing fine-grained access permissions using role-based, attribute-based, and policy-as-code approaches.

product.name: Privileged Access Management (PAM)
product.description: A security feature that enforces least privilege access and monitors privileged user activities with audit logging.

product.name: Automated Auditing and Reporting
product.description: Tools that provide real-time monitoring, log access, session tracking, and compliance reporting to maintain data security.

identifier.value: Integration with External Services and Cloud Providers

product.name: Integration with External Services and Cloud Providers
product.description: Capabilities to synchronize identities and integrate with cloud providers, SaaS, and infrastructure tools for unified access management.
